name: Facebook Content Monetization
hook: Want to build toward 500 dollars a month with Facebook? Let me show you the process from account setup to monetization.
verification_note: Facebook may require email or phone verification. Use the code Facebook sends to your own email or phone.
earning_steps: Set up your creator or professional presence where available.
Check the monetization products and eligibility shown for your account.
Track your performance and available earnings inside your dashboard.

name: Upwork Freelancing
hook: Want to build toward 500 dollars a month freelancing? Let's create the account and show the next steps.
verification_note: If Upwork asks for verification, complete the real verification on your own account. Never use demo information for identity verification.
earning_steps: Select Freelancer when asked how you want to use the platform.
Search for projects matching your skills.
Complete projects professionally and build reviews.

name: Fiverr Freelancing
hook: Want to build toward 500 dollars a month selling a skill online? Let's look at Fiverr step by step.
verification_note: Fiverr may send a verification code to your email. Use the real code sent to your own account.
earning_steps: Create your account with an email you control.
Activate the account using the real verification code.
Create a clear Gig for one service.
Add pricing, delivery time and examples.
Publish and improve your Gig based on real customer demand.
